summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Order-for-Dealer feature (iteration 25). Backend: 11/11 tests passed - all endpoints working correctly. Frontend: All UI elements verified - shopping cart button, dealer dialog, options checkboxes, price calculation, and order placement with success toast.

Backend: POST /api/admin/order-for-dealer creates order successfully
Backend: order-for-dealer marks motorcycle as unavailable after order
Backend: order-for-dealer returns order_id and message with dealer company name
Backend: order-for-dealer returns 404 for non-existent dealer
Backend: order-for-dealer returns 404 for non-existent motorcycle
Backend: order-for-dealer returns 400 if motorcycle is not available
Backend: order-for-dealer requires admin auth (401/403 without auth)
Backend: Motorcycle availability can be reset via PUT /api/motorcycles/{id}

Frontend: Dialog shows dealer search/filter input

Frontend: Dialog shows inspection checkbox with price (+€125)
